# Vendored third-party assets

Served from our own origin so the Content-Security-Policy can stay `'self'`
(no third-party script hosts).

| Library | Version | Source | License | SHA-256 (leaflet.js) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz | BSD-2-Clause | `db49d009c841f5ca34a888c96511ae936fd9f5533e90d8b2c4d57596f4e5641a` |

Update by downloading the new npm tarball, copying `dist/leaflet.js` and
